Require Export compat.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat.

Notation name  := nat.

Definition nat_pair_eq_dec : forall n m : name * name, {n = m} + {n <> m} :=
  ltac:(decide equality; decide equality; decide equality).

Opaque nat_pair_eq_dec.
Require Import Bool Arith ZArith List Eqdep Lia PeanoNat Relations EquivDec Program.Equality String operations pi_syntax pairEq type_system.

Section TypeSystemRules.

Inductive cons (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : Prop :=
  | Co_nil : g = nil -> cons g pf
  | Co_top : forall n pf',
      typeOf g n Top ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_un : forall n p t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan un p t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf
  | Co_lin : forall n t pf',
      typeOf g n (Chan lin empty t) ->
      cons (removeEntry n g) pf' ->
      cons g pf.

Inductive typeCheck (g : typeEnv) (pf : isMap g) : dproc -> Prop :=
  | TNil :  cons g pf -> typeCheck g pf dZero
  | TNew : forall p n t pf1,
      In (n, hid, t) g ->
      typeCheck ((n, vis, t) :: (removeEntry n g)) pf1 p ->
      typeCheck g  pf (dNu (fst n) (snd n) p)
  | TPar : forall g1 g2 p1 p2 pf1 pf2,
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g pf1 pf2 pf ->
      typeCheck g1 pf1 p1 ->
      typeCheck g2 pf2 p2 ->
      typeCheck g pf (dPar p1 p2)
  | TOutL : forall u p t v t' q t1 t2 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin out t) t1 ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v (removeEntry u g))) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TOutUn : forall u p t v t' q t2 pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = out) ->
      type_remove t' t t2 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      In (v, vis, t') g ->
      typeCheck
        ((v, vis, t2) :: (removeEntry v g)) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dOut (fst u) (snd u) (fst v) (snd v) q)
  | TInL : forall u p t x q t1 pf1,
      type_remove (Chan lin p t) (Chan lin inp t) t1 ->
      In (u, vis, Chan lin p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck
        ((u, vis, t1) :: (x, vis, t) :: removeEntry u g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInUn : forall u p t x q pf1,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      typeCheck ((x, vis, t) ::  g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dInp (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q)
  | TInU : forall u p t x q pf1 pf2,
      (p = io \/ p = inp) ->
      In (u, vis, Chan un p t) g ->
      ~In x (domain g) ->
      snd x < max (domain g) ->
      cons (vis_proj g ++ ill_proj g) pf2 ->
      typeCheck ( (x, vis, t) :: g) pf1 q ->
      typeCheck
        g pf (dBang (fst u) (snd u) (fst x) (snd x) q).

End TypeSystemRules.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat operations pi_syntax pairEq.

Section TypeSystem.

Inductive pol : Set := empty | inp | out | io.

Inductive mode : Set := lin | un.

Inductive piType : Set :=
  | Chan : mode -> pol -> piType -> piType
  | Top : piType.

Inductive flag : Set := hid | ill | vis.

Definition isMap (l : list ((name * name) * flag * piType)) :=
    forall x f1 t1 f2 t2,
      In (x, f1, t1) l /\ In (x, f2, t2) l ->
      f1 = f2 /\ t1 = t2.

Definition typeEnv := list ((name * name) * flag * piType).

Fixpoint pol_eq (p1 p2 : pol) : bool :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, empty | inp, inp | out, out | io, io => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint mode_eq (m1 m2 : mode) : bool :=
    match m1, m2 with
    | lin, lin | un, un => true
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint type_eq (t1 t2 : piType) : bool :=
    match t1, t2 with
    | Top, Top => true
    | Chan m1 p1 t1, Chan m2 p2 t2 =>
      if mode_eq m1 m2
      then (if pol_eq p1 p2 then type_eq t1 t2 else false)
      else false
    | _, _ => false
    end.

Fixpoint flag_eq (f1 f2 : flag) : bool :=
    match f1, f2 with
    | hid, hid | ill, ill | vis, vis => true
    | _, _  => false
    end.

Fixpoint removeEntry (y : (name * name)) (g : typeEnv) :=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (x, f, t) :: tail =>
      if pair_eq x y
      then
        tail
      else (x, f, t) :: removeEntry y tail
    end.

Inductive typeOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> piType -> Prop :=
  | T_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> typeOf g n t.

Inductive flagOf : typeEnv -> (name * name) -> flag -> Prop :=
  | F_Entry : forall g n f t,
      In (n, f, t) g -> flagOf g n f.

Fixpoint pol_cup (p1 p2 : pol) : pol :=
    match p1, p2 with
    | empty, _ => p2
    | io, _ => io
    | _, io => io
    | out, inp => io
    | out, _ => out
    | inp, out => io
    | inp, _ => inp
    end.

Inductive pol_plus : pol -> pol -> pol -> Prop :=
  | Pp_emptyL : forall p, pol_plus empty p p
  | Pp_emptyR : forall p, pol_plus p empty p
  | Pp_inpL:  pol_plus inp out io
  | Pp_inpR:  pol_plus out inp io.

Inductive type_plus : piType -> piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Tp_Base : type_plus Top Top Top
  | Tp_LinPlus : forall p1 p2 p t,
      pol_plus p1 p2 p ->
      type_plus (Chan lin p1 t) (Chan lin p2 t) (Chan lin p t)
  | Tp_UnPlus : forall p1 p2 t,
      type_plus (Chan un p1 t) (Chan un p2 t) (Chan un (pol_cup p1 p2) t).

Definition is_linear (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan lin p t'.

Definition is_unrestricted (t : piType) :=
    exists p t', t = Chan un p t'.

Inductive type_sub : piType -> piType -> Prop :=
  | Ts_id : forall t,
      type_sub t t
  | Ts_empty : forall m q t,
      type_sub (Chan m empty t) (Chan m q t)
  | Ts_inp : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m inp t) (Chan m io t)
  | Ts_out : forall m t,
      type_sub (Chan m out t) (Chan m io t).

Definition type_remove (t : piType) (s : piType) (r : piType) :=
    type_sub s t /\ type_plus s r t /\ (is_unrestricted t -> r = t).

Inductive flag_plus : flag -> flag -> flag -> Prop :=
  | Fp_hi : flag_plus hid ill hid
  | Fp_ih : flag_plus ill hid hid
  | Fp_vv : flag_plus vis vis vis
  | Fp_ii : flag_plus ill ill ill.

Inductive tEnv_split (g1 : typeEnv) (g2 : typeEnv) (g3 : typeEnv)
            (pf1 : isMap g1) (pf2 : isMap g2) (pf3 : isMap g3) : Prop :=
  | SpNil : g1 = nil -> g2 = nil -> g3 = nil ->
            tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpLin : forall n f f' g p q p' t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      pol_plus p q p' ->
      In (n, f, Chan lin p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan lin q t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan lin p' t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpUn : forall n f f' g p t g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Chan un p t) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Chan un p t) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n (Chan un p t) ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3
  | SpTop :  forall n f f' g g''' pf' pf'' pf''',
      flag_plus f g f'->
      In (n, f, Top) g1 ->
      In (n, g, Top) g2 ->
      tEnv_split (removeEntry n g1) (removeEntry n g2) g''' pf' pf'' pf''' ->
      removeEntry n g3 = g''' ->
      flagOf g3 n f' ->
      typeOf g3 n Top ->
      tEnv_split g1 g2 g3 pf1 pf2 pf3.

Fixpoint domain (g: typeEnv) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match g with
    | (x, _, _) :: t => x :: domain t
    | nil => nil
    end.

Fixpoint hid_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, hid, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, hid, t) :: hid_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       hid_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint vis_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, vis, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, vis, t) :: vis_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       vis_proj m
    end.

Fixpoint ill_proj (g : typeEnv) : typeEnv:=
    match g with
    | nil => nil
    | (a1, a2, ill, t) :: m =>
      (a1, a2, ill, t) :: ill_proj m
    |  (a1, a2, f, t) :: m =>
       ill_proj m
    end.

End TypeSystem.

Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Notation name  := nat.

Section ProcessDefinitions.

Inductive dproc : Set :=
  | dZero : dproc
  | dBang : name -> name -> name -> name ->dproc -> dproc
  | dPar : dproc -> dproc -> dproc
  | dNu : name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dInp : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc
  | dOut : name -> name -> name -> name -> dproc -> dproc.

Fixpoint secLabs (p : dproc)  :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang _ _ _ _ p | dInp _ _ _ _ p | dOut _ _ _ _ p => secLabs p
    | dPar p q => secLabs q ++ secLabs p
    | dNu h i  p =>  secLabs p ++ (h, i) :: nil
    end.

Fixpoint fn (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  => nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (y1, y2) ((x1, x2) :: fn p)
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      fn p1 ++  fn p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      List.remove nat_pair_eq_dec (a1, a2) (fn p)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      (x1, x2) :: (y1, y2) :: fn p
    end.

Fixpoint bv (p : dproc) : list (nat * nat) :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>
      nil
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  p =>
      (y1, y2) :: bv p
    | dPar p1 p2 =>
      bv p1 ++  bv p2
    | dNu a1 a2 p =>
      bv p
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      bv p
    end.

Definition wf (p : dproc) : Prop :=
    NoDup (secLabs p) /\ disjoint (fn p) (secLabs p).

Definition pos l := forall x1 x2 : nat,
      In (x1, x2) l-> x2 > 0.

Definition sl_pos p := pos (secLabs p).

Definition mv (py pz pv : name * name)  :=
    let (y1, y2) := (fst py, snd py) in
    let (z1, z2) := (fst pz, snd pz) in
    let (v1, v2) := (fst pv, snd pv) in
    if (y1 =? z1) && (y2 =? z2)
    then (v1, v2)
    else (y1, y2).

Fixpoint pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2 :=
    match p with
    | dZero  =>  p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dBang (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2 (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2  q =>
      let r := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dInp (fst r) (snd r) y1 y2  (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      let r1 := mv (x1, x2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      let r2 := mv (y1, y2) (z1, z2) (v1, v2) in
      dOut  (fst r1) (snd r1) (fst r2) (snd r2) (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dPar p q =>
      dPar (pmap p z1 z2 v1 v2) (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    | dNu h i q =>
      dNu h i (pmap q z1 z2 v1 v2)
    end.

Definition map_nat_nat := list (nat * nat).

Fixpoint  domain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (k, _) :: t => k :: (domain_projection t)
    end.

Fixpoint  codomain_projection (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    match m with
    | nil => nil
    | (_, v) :: t => v :: (codomain_projection t)
    end.

Definition structure_is_map (m : map_nat_nat) :=
    NoDup (domain_projection m).

Fixpoint max (l :list (nat*nat)) : nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => 0
    | (_, x) :: t => let m := max t in
                     if x <? m then m else x
    end.

Notation dp := domain_projection.

Notation cp := codomain_projection.

Local Definition no_dup_cont (h : nat * nat) (t : list (nat * nat))
    (pf : NoDup (h :: t)) : NoDup t := ltac:(inversion pf; assumption).

Local Opaque no_dup_cont.

Fixpoint dep_map_gen_r (l :list (name * name)) (m : nat) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    match l with
    | nil => fun _ => nil
    | h :: t =>
      fun pf : NoDup (h :: t)  =>
        (fst h, snd h + m) :: (dep_map_gen_r t m (no_dup_cont h t pf))
    end.

Definition dep_map_gen (l :list (name * name)) : NoDup l -> map_nat_nat :=
    dep_map_gen_r l (max l).

Fixpoint dep_relabel (p : dproc) (s : list (name*name)) : NoDup s -> dproc :=
    match p with
    | dZero   => fun _  => p
    | dBang x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dBang  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dInp x1 x2 y1 y2 p =>
      fun pf : NoDup  s => dInp  x1 x2 y1 y2 (dep_relabel p s pf)
    | dOut x1 x2 y1 y2 p  =>
      fun pf : NoDup s => dOut x1 x2 y1 y2  (dep_relabel p s pf )
    | dPar p q =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dPar (dep_relabel p s pf) (dep_relabel q s pf)
    | dNu h i p =>
      fun pf : NoDup s =>
        dNu h (i + max s) (pmap (dep_relabel p s pf) h i h (i + max s))
    end.

End ProcessDefinitions.

Section Semantics.

Inductive action : Set :=
  | aIn : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aOut : nat -> nat -> nat -> nat -> action
  | aTau : nat -> nat -> action.

Fixpoint InB a g : ((flag * piType) * bool) :=
    match g with
    | nil => ((ill, Top), false)
    | (b, f, t) :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then ((f, t), true) else InB a m
    end.

Fixpoint newEntries (g : typeEnv) (l : list (name * name)) (max : nat) : typeEnv :=
    match l with
    | (a1, a2) :: tail =>
      let (_, notNew) := InB (a1, a2) g in
      if notNew
      then newEntries g tail max
      else
        let (pair, _) := InB (a1, a2 - max) g in
        ((a1, a2), fst pair, snd pair) :: newEntries g tail max
    | nil => nil
    end.

Definition notHidden c1 c2 act :=
    match act with
    | aIn a1 a2 b1 b2
    | aOut a1 a2 b1 b2 =>
      (a1, a2)<> (c1, c2) /\ (b1, b2) <> (c1, c2)

Section ListOperations.

Fixpoint disjoint {A} (l1 l2 : list A) : Prop :=
    match l1 with
    | nil => True
    | x::t1 => ((In x l2) -> False) /\ disjoint t1 l2
    end.

Inductive  disjoint_2 {A}: list A -> list A -> Prop :=
  | dis_nil : forall l : list A, disjoint_2 nil l
  | dis_cons : forall (x:A) (l1 l2 : list A),
      (~ In x l2 /\ disjoint_2 l1 l2) -> disjoint_2 (x::l1) l2.

End  ListOperations.
Require Import Bool List Lia PeanoNat header operations.

Section PairEq.

Definition pair_eq (p1 p2 : name * name) :=
    (fst p1 =? fst p2) && (snd p1 =? snd p2).

Fixpoint In2 a l :=
    match l with
    | nil => false
    | b :: m =>
      if pair_eq a b then true else In2 a m
    end.

End PairEq.

From Stdlib Require Import List Bool PeanoNat Lia.

Import ListNotations.

Local Lemma pair_eq_true x y : pair_eq x y = true <-> x = y.
Proof.
  destruct x, y; unfold pair_eq; cbn.
  rewrite andb_true_iff, "'!Nat.eqb_eq.
  split; [intros [-> ->] | intros E; inversion E]; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma pair_eq_false x y : pair_eq x y = false <-> x <> y.
Proof. rewrite <- pair_eq_true. destruct (pair_eq x y); intuition discriminate. Qed.

Local Definition key := (nat * nat)%type.
Local Definition entry := (flag * piType)%type.
Local Definition env := key -> option entry.

Local Definition fetch (g : typeEnv) : env :=
  fun k => let '"'(v,b) := InB k g in if b then Some v else None.

Local Definition update (e : env) (k : key) (v : option entry) : env :=
  fun x => if pair_eq x k then v else e x.

Local Lemma update_eq e k v : update e k v k = v.
Proof. unfold update; rewrite (proj2 (pair_eq_true _ _) eq_refl); reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma update_neq e k x v : x <> k -> update e k v x = e x.
Proof. intros N. unfold update; rewrite (proj2 (pair_eq_false _ _) N); reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma fetch_empty x : fetch [] x = None.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma fetch_cons g k f t :
  fetch ((k,f,t)::g) = update (fetch g) k (Some (f,t)).
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma fetch_sound g k f t :
  fetch g k = Some (f,t) -> In (k,f,t) g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[j h] s] g IH]; [discriminate|].
  rewrite fetch_cons. unfold update. destruct (pair_eq k j) eqn:E.
  - apply pair_eq_true in E. subst. intros H; inversion H; subst; left; reflexivity.
  - right; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma fetch_complete g (M : isMap g) k f t :
  In (k,f,t) g -> fetch g k = Some (f,t).
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[j h] s] g IH]; [contradiction|].
  intros I. rewrite fetch_cons. unfold update. destruct (pair_eq k j) eqn:E.
  - apply pair_eq_true in E. subst j.
    destruct (M k h s f t) as [-> ->]; auto with datatypes.
  - apply IH.
    + intros x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2]. apply M; auto with datatypes.
    + destruct I as [I|I]; auto. inversion I; subst.
      apply pair_eq_false in E. contradiction.
Qed.

Local Lemma domain_spec g k : In k (domain g) <-> exists f t, In (k,f,t) g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[j h] s] g IH]; simpl.
  - firstorder.
  - rewrite IH. split.
    + intros [<-|[f [t I]]]; eauto.
    + intros [f [t [I|I]]]; [inversion I|]; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma fetch_domain g k : In k (domain g) <-> exists v, fetch g k = Some v.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[j h] s] g IH]; [simpl; split; [contradiction|intros [? E]; discriminate]|].
  rewrite fetch_cons. simpl. rewrite IH. unfold update.
  destruct (pair_eq k j) eqn:E.
  - apply pair_eq_true in E. subst. firstorder.
  - apply pair_eq_false in E. firstorder.
Qed.

Local Lemma removeEntry_other g k j f t : j <> k ->
  In (j,f,t) (removeEntry k g) <-> In (j,f,t) g.
Proof.
  intros N. induction g as [|[[i h] s] g IH]; simpl; [tauto|].
  destruct (pair_eq i k) eqn:E; simpl.
  - apply pair_eq_true in E. subst. intuition congruence.
  - rewrite IH. tauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma removeEntry_subset g k x :
  In x (removeEntry k g) -> In x g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[j f] t] g IH]; simpl; [tauto|].
  destruct (pair_eq j k); simpl; tauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma removeEntry_map g k : isMap g -> isMap (removeEntry k g).
Proof. intros M x f1 t1 f2 t2 [H1 H2]. apply M; eauto using removeEntry_subset. Qed.

Local Lemma removeEntry_domain g k : NoDup (domain g) ->
  forall x, In x (domain (removeEntry k g)) <-> x <> k /\\ In x (domain g).
Proof.
  intros ND x. induction g as [|[[j f] t] g IH]; simpl in *; [tauto|].
  inversion ND as [|? ? H1 H2]; subst.
  destruct (pair_eq j k) eqn:E; simpl.
  - apply pair_eq_true in E. subst. intuition congruence.
  - apply pair_eq_false in E. rewrite IH by assumption. intuition congruence.
Qed.

Local Lemma removeEntry_nodup g k :
  NoDup (domain g) -> NoDup (domain (removeEntry k g)).
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[j f] t] g IH]; cbn; auto.
  intros ND. inversion ND as [|? ? H1 H2]; subst.
  destruct (pair_eq j k); cbn; auto.
  constructor; auto.
  rewrite removeEntry_domain by assumption. tauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma nodup_map g : NoDup (domain g) -> isMap g.
Proof.
  induction g as [|[[j f] t] g IH]; [unfold isMap; simpl; tauto|].
  intros ND x f1 t1 f2 t2 [I1 I2]. inversion ND as [|? ? H1 H2]; subst.
  destruct I1 as [I1|I1], I2 as [I2|I2]; try solve [eapply IH; eauto].
  - congruence.
  - inversion I1; subst. exfalso. apply H1, domain_spec. eauto.
  - inversion I2; subst. exfalso. apply H1, domain_spec. eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma fetch_remove g k j : NoDup (domain g) ->
  fetch (removeEntry k g) j = update (fetch g) k None j.
Proof.
  intros ND. destruct (pair_eq j k) eqn:E.
  - apply pair_eq_true in E. subst. rewrite update_eq.
    destruct (fetch (removeEntry k g) k) as [v|] eqn:F; auto.
    exfalso. assert (In k (domain (removeEntry k g))) by (apply fetch_domain; eauto).
    apply removeEntry_domain in H; tauto.
  - apply pair_eq_false in E. rewrite update_neq by assumption.
    destruct (fetch g j) as [[f t]|] eqn:F.
    + apply fetch_complete, removeEntry_other; eauto using nodup_map, removeEntry_map, fetch_sound.
    + destruct (fetch (removeEntry k g) j) as [[f t]|] eqn:G; auto.
      apply fetch_sound, removeEntry_other in G; auto.
      apply (fetch_complete g (nodup_map g ND)) in G. congruence.
Qed.
EOF

Local Lemma mtyped_ext m E p :
  mtyped m E p -> forall D, (forall x, E x = D x) -> mtyped m D p.
Proof.
  intros T. induction T; intros D EQ.
  all: try (econstructor; try solve [eauto | intros k; symmetry in EQ; eauto]).
  all: try solve [intros k f t V; apply H with (k:=k) (f:=f); now rewrite EQ].
  all: try solve [intro k; rewrite <- EQ; auto].
  all: try solve [apply IHT; intro k; unfold set, update; now rewrite EQ].
  all: try solve [intros k f t V N; eapply H3; [now rewrite EQ|exact N]].
Qed.

Local Lemma typeCheck_to_m g M p :
  typeCheck g M p -> NoDup (domain g) ->
  mtyped (max (domain g)) (fetch g) p.
Proof.
  intros C. induction C; intro ND.
  - constructor. intros k f t E. eapply (proj1 (cons_all _ _) H).
    eapply fetch_sound; eauto.
  - eapply mt_nu.
    + eapply fetch_complete; eauto.
    + specialize (IHC (set_nodup _ _ _ _ ND)).
      rewrite (max_equiv _ _ (set_domain _ _ _ _ ND ltac:(apply domain_spec; eauto))) in IHC.
      eapply mtyped_ext; [exact IHC|].
      eapply set_list; eauto. reflexivity.
  - destruct (split_domains _ _ _ _ _ _ H) as [P1 P2].
    pose proof (Permutation_in _ P1) as I1.
    assert (N1 : NoDup (domain g1)) by (eapply Permutation_NoDup; [symmetry; exact P1|assumption]).
    assert (N2 : NoDup (domain g2)) by (eapply Permutation_NoDup; [symmetry; exact P2|assumption]).
    specialize (IHC1 N1). specialize (IHC2 N2).
    assert (E1 : max (domain g1) = max (domain g)).
    { apply max_equiv; intro k. split; apply Permutation_in; [exact P1|symmetry; exact P1]. }
    assert (E2 : max (domain g2) = max (domain g)).
    { apply max_equiv; intro k. split; apply Permutation_in; [exact P2|symmetry; exact P2]. }
    rewrite E1 in IHC1. rewrite E2 in IHC2.
    eapply mt_par; eauto using split_join.
  - assert (A := fetch_complete _ pf _ _ _ H1).
    assert (B := fetch_complete _ pf _ _ _ H2).
    assert (N : u <> v) by (eapply out_distinct; eauto).
    destruct (list_two_set_domain g u v vis t1 vis t2 ND
      ltac:(apply domain_spec; eauto) ltac:(apply domain_spec; eauto) N) as [ND' EQ].
    specialize (IHC ND'). rewrite (max_equiv _ _ EQ) in IHC.
    eapply mt_out_lin; try eassumption. eapply mtyped_ext; [exact IHC|].
    eapply list_two_set; eauto. reflexivity.
  - specialize (IHC (set_nodup _ _ _ _ ND)).
    rewrite (max_equiv _ _ (set_domain _ _ _ _ ND ltac:(apply domain_spec; eauto))) in IHC.
    eapply mt_out_un; eauto using fetch_complete.
    eapply mtyped_ext; [exact IHC|]. eapply set_list; eauto. reflexivity.
  - destruct (list_in_set_domain g u x t1 t ND
      ltac:(apply domain_spec; eauto) H1) as [ND' EQ].
    specialize (IHC ND'). rewrite (max_equiv _ _ EQ), max_add in IHC by lia.
    eapply mt_in_lin; eauto using fetch_complete, fetch_none.
    eapply mtyped_ext; [exact IHC|].
    eapply list_in_set; eauto. 2: reflexivity.
    intros <-. apply H1, domain_spec; eauto.
  - assert (ND' : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::g))) by (simpl; constructor; assumption).
    specialize (IHC ND'). cbn in IHC.
    change (mtyped (max (x :: domain g)) _ _) in IHC. rewrite max_add in IHC by lia.
    eapply mt_in_un; eauto using fetch_complete, fetch_none.
    eapply mtyped_ext; [exact IHC|]. apply add_list. reflexivity.
  - assert (ND' : NoDup (domain ((x,vis,t)::g))) by (simpl; constructor; assumption).
    specialize (IHC ND').
    change (mtyped (max (x :: domain g)) _ _) in IHC. rewrite max_add in IHC by lia.
    eapply mt_bang; eauto using fetch_complete, fetch_none.
    + intros k f s V F. apply (proj1 (cons_all _ _) H3) with (k:=k) (f:=f).
      apply projected_in. eauto using fetch_sound.
    + eapply mtyped_ext; [exact IHC|]. apply add_list. reflexivity.
Qed.
EOF

Local Definition mentions (p : dproc) := 
  let fix loop p :=
    match p with
    | dZero => []
    | dNu a b q | dInp a b _ _ q | dBang a b _ _ q => (a,b) :: loop q
    | dOut a b c d q => (a,b) :: (c,d) :: loop q
    | dPar q r => loop q ++ loop r
    end
  in loop p.

Local Fixpoint rename_refs (r : key -> key) (p : dproc) : dproc :=
  match p with
  | dZero => dZero
  | dNu a b q =>
      dNu (fst (r (a,b))) (snd (r (a,b))) (rename_refs r q)
  | dInp a b c d q =>
      dInp (fst (r (a,b))) (snd (r (a,b))) c d (rename_refs r q)
  | dBang a b c d q =>
      dBang (fst (r (a,b))) (snd (r (a,b))) c d (rename_refs r q)
  | dOut a b c d q =>
      dOut (fst (r (a,b))) (snd (r (a,b)))
        (fst (r (c,d))) (snd (r (c,d))) (rename_refs r q)
  | dPar q r' => dPar (rename_refs r q) (rename_refs r r')
  end.

Local Lemma rename_agrees p r s :
  (forall k, In k (mentions p) -> r k = s k) ->
  rename_refs r p = rename_refs s p.
Proof.
  induction p; simpl; intros H; try reflexivity.
  all: try solve [f_equal; [apply IHp1|apply IHp2]; intros k K; apply H, in_app_iff; auto].
  all: rewrite (H (_,_) (or_introl eq_refl));
    try rewrite (H (_,_) (or_intror (or_introl eq_refl)));
    f_equal; apply IHp; intros k K; apply H; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_compose p r s :
  rename_refs r (rename_refs s p) = rename_refs (fun k => r (s k)) p.
Proof.
  induction p; simpl; try rewrite IHp; try rewrite IHp1, IHp2;
    repeat match goal with |- context [(fst ?k, snd ?k)] =>
      replace (fst k, snd k) with k by (destruct k; reflexivity)
    end; reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_identity p : rename_refs (fun k => k) p = p.
Proof. induction p; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_set (r : key -> key) E k f t :
  (forall x, r (r x) = x) ->
  forall j, set E k f t (r j) = set (fun x => E (r x)) (r k) f t j.
Proof.
  intros Inv j. unfold set, update.
  destruct (pair_eq (r j) k) eqn:P, (pair_eq j (r k)) eqn:Q; auto.
  - apply pair_eq_true in P; apply pair_eq_false in Q. apply (f_equal r) in P.
    rewrite Inv in P; contradiction.
  - apply pair_eq_false in P; apply pair_eq_true in Q. subst. rewrite Inv in P; contradiction.

  mtyped m E p ->
  (forall x, r (r x) = x) ->
  (forall k, In k (bv p) -> r k = k) ->
  mtyped m (fun x => E (r x)) (rename_refs r p).

  all: repeat match goal with |- context [(fst ?k, snd ?k)] =>
      replace (fst k, snd k) with k by (destruct k; reflexivity)
    end.
  - constructor. intros k f t K. eapply (H (r k)); eassumption.
  - eapply mt_nu with (t:=t); [now rewrite R|].
    eapply mtyped_ext; [apply IHT; exact BV|apply rename_set; exact R].
  - eapply mt_par with (E1:=fun k => E1 (r k)) (E2:=fun k => E2 (r k)).

    + apply IHT1. intros k K. apply BV, in_app_iff; auto.

  - eapply mt_out_lin with (p:=p) (t:=t) (s:=s) (r:=r0) (u:=u); try assumption;
      try (now rewrite R).
    eapply mtyped_ext; [apply IHT; exact BV|].
    intro j. rewrite rename_set by assumption. apply set_congr. apply rename_set; assumption.
  - eapply mt_out_un with (p:=p) (t:=t) (s:=s) (u:=u); try assumption; try (now rewrite R).
    eapply mtyped_ext; [apply IHT; exact BV|apply rename_set; assumption].
  - assert (B : r b = b) by (apply BV; left; destruct b; reflexivity).
    eapply mt_in_lin with (p:=p) (t:=t) (r:=r0); try assumption; try (now rewrite R); try (now rewrite B).
    eapply mtyped_ext; [apply IHT; intros j K; apply BV; right; exact K|].
    intro j. rewrite rename_set by assumption. rewrite B. apply set_congr. apply rename_set; assumption.
  - assert (B : r b = b) by (apply BV; left; destruct b; reflexivity).
    eapply mt_in_un with (p:=p) (t:=t); try assumption; try (now rewrite R); try (now rewrite B).
    eapply mtyped_ext; [apply IHT; intros j K; apply BV; right; exact K|].
    intro j. rewrite rename_set by assumption. now rewrite B.
  - assert (B : r b = b) by (apply BV; left; destruct b; reflexivity).
    eapply mt_bang with (p:=p) (t:=t); try assumption; try (now rewrite R); try (now rewrite B).
    + intros k f s V NF. eapply (H3 (r k)); eassumption.
    + eapply mtyped_ext; [apply IHT; intros j K; apply BV; right; exact K|].
      intro j. rewrite rename_set by assumption. now rewrite B.
Qed.

  destruct (scoped_restrictions _ _ _ T) as [S _].
  assert (ND : NoDup (domain g')) by (eapply lts_nodup; eassumption).
  assert (B : max (domain g) <= max (domain g')).
